title: Campaigns
description: Send approved WhatsApp templates to contacts who have given marketing permission.
denied: Only workspace owners and admins can manage campaigns.
error: Could not load records. Try again.
name: Name
templateHelp: Use consecutive variables such as {{1}}. Submit your template, then sync its Meta approval status. Only approved text templates can be used.
importHelp: Include phone, name and optional language or attributes. Consent requires both opt_in_at and opt_in_source. Imports never reverse STOP opt-outs.
imported: Import complete: {processed} processed, {created} created, {updated} updated, {consents_recorded} consent records.
sourceHelp: Record permission only when you hold the customer's consent. Include a form or request reference.
consentConfirm: Update this contact's recorded marketing permission? You must hold the underlying consent or opt-out request.
deleteConfirm: Delete this saved segment? Existing campaign snapshots remain unchanged.
segmentHelp: Language and field filters match exactly. Field names come from contact imports, such as city.
priceHelp: Optional estimate in the chosen currency. Meta bills you directly; actual charges can vary by country and category.
needCatalog: Create an approved template and an audience segment first.
ownAttestation: This is my own number and it has recorded marketing permission.
testHelp: Import your own number with consent first. A test sends only to that number and is excluded from campaign totals.
testMissing: No opted-in contact matches that number. Import it with consent before testing.
testQueued: Test queued. Wait for acceptance, then review the message on your phone.
testFailed: The test failed or its delivery is unknown. Check the recipient results before creating another draft.
reviewed: I received and reviewed the test message.
localTime: Times use your browser time zone:
confirmHelp: This sends the frozen preview to the eligible audience. Consent and template approval are checked again when sending.
cancelConfirm: Stop future sends for this campaign? Messages already in flight cannot be recalled.
reconnecting: Reconnecting… Results also refresh every five seconds.
testsExcluded: Own-number tests are excluded from campaign totals.
unknownHelp: Unknown delivery is not retried automatically. Inspect these recipients before sending again.

reasons.channel_quality: Channel quality or messaging capacity needs review. Resolve it before explicitly resuming.
reasons.template_changed: The approved template changed. Create a new campaign.
reasons.channel_changed: The sending phone changed. Create a new campaign.
reasons.daily_limit: Waiting for the shared daily budget
reasons.channel_unavailable: Channel verification or access is unavailable
